chunks: And Jamīl ibn Darrāj narrated from ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “The ghurrah is sometimes one hundred dīnārs and sometimes ten dīnārs.” So he said: “Fifty.”

key_terms.الْغُرَّةَ: the prescribed compensation for a miscarried fetus
key_terms.بِخَمْسِينَ: fifty dīnārs; the Imam’s stated ruling
key_terms.عَشَرَةِ دَنَانِيرَ: ten dīnārs as a proposed valuation
key_terms.مِائَةِ دِينَارٍ: one hundred dīnārs as a proposed valuation

ai.seo_question: What is the amount of the ghurrah for a fetus according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the amount of the ghurrah, the compensation due in the case discussed in this chapter concerning the fetus. When differing valuations were mentioned, Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام gave the ruling that it is fifty dīnārs.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5320 - In the narration of Jamil ibn Darraj from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, he said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as): "The ghurra (compensation for a miscarried fetus) is sometimes valued at one hundred dinars and sometimes at ten dinars."
Imam (as) replied: "It is fifty."
